_meta.note: Pluggable Stage-B executor: HeartBeat stays the deterministic brain; agno/crewai/claude-code/script back the worker via a JSON wire protocol. Decisions locked: all-three backends, escalate-only on gate_blocked, serial-first, strict gates in autonomous mode. Verified by tests/run-tests.sh (the real gate).

tasks.title: Author the gate spec (T36)
tasks.description: Add T36 assertions to tests/run-tests.sh covering the hb-exec driver against a python-free stub backend: drive to all_done, per-task attempt-cap escalation, strict refusal of a non-behavioral gate, and adversarial refute pass/fail.

tasks.title: Implement the driver
tasks.description: Implement plugin/templates/hb-exec.js: the serial run loop (tick -> route -> dispatch -> gate), the execute/refute wire protocol, the lease heartbeat pump, context assembly from settled reality, escalate-only policy, per-task attempt cap, and strict mode. CLI-guarded so it is requirable; exports run.

tasks.title: Ship it via bootstrap
tasks.description: Update plugin/bootstrap.sh to copy hb-exec.js and the executors/ directory into each project's .hb/, and chmod them.

tasks.title: Author the gate spec (T37)
tasks.description: Add T37 to tests/run-tests.sh: plugin/templates/executors/agno_exec.py is valid and degrades to protocol-valid JSON (execute -> ok:false, refute -> refuted:false) when the agno library is absent.

tasks.title: Implement agno_exec.py
tasks.description: Implement plugin/templates/executors/agno_exec.py implementing execute and refute over the wire protocol, wrapping an Agno agent, with graceful degrade when agno is not installed.

tasks.title: Author the gate spec (T38)
tasks.description: Add T38 to tests/run-tests.sh: plugin/templates/executors/crewai_exec.py is valid and degrades to protocol-valid JSON when the crewai library is absent.

tasks.title: Implement crewai_exec.py
tasks.description: Implement plugin/templates/executors/crewai_exec.py over the same wire protocol; document that a HeartBeat task is not a CrewAI Task.

tasks.title: Author the gate spec (T39)
tasks.description: Add T39 to tests/run-tests.sh: bootstrap copies hb-exec.js and executors into .hb/, and the SKILL help text mentions the exec command.

tasks.title: Docs + version bump
tasks.description: Add /heartbeat exec to SKILL.md and bump the version to 1.8.0 across plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, STATUS.md, and README.md.

tasks.title: Rebuild the zip
tasks.description: Rebuild heartbeat-v1.8.0.zip excluding .git/.claude and extract-test it on a clean path.

tasks.title: Author the gate spec (T40)
tasks.description: Add T40 to tests/run-tests.sh: parallel fan-out drives a multi-task phase to completion via the stub backend, and git worktree isolation lands each task's file into the main tree with a clean merge and worktree cleanup.

tasks.title: Implement parallel mode
tasks.description: Implement parallel mode in plugin/templates/hb-exec.js: on next_task with concurrency>1, free the tick lease, fan out hb ready N concurrently, run each task in its own git worktree (in-place fallback without git), serialize the merge-back, and discard a worktree on failure. Add --parallel N and HB_MAX_CONCURRENCY.

tasks.title: Author the gate spec (T41)
tasks.description: Add T41 to tests/run-tests.sh: ollama_exec.py is valid python and degrades to protocol-valid JSON when the ollama server is unreachable. Add tests/real-backend.sh for a live end-to-end run.

tasks.title: Implement ollama_exec.py
tasks.description: Implement plugin/templates/executors/ollama_exec.py using stdlib urllib: a FILE-block mini-agent for execute (the model emits file blocks the backend writes) and a skeptic for refute. Document the ollama backend in SKILL.md.

tasks.title: Run the live end-to-end test
tasks.description: Run tests/real-backend.sh live against qwen2.5:7b-instruct: drive a tiny project whose behavioral gate compiles and runs the model-written code, and record the result.

GATE_E0.desc: The driver mediates Stage B correctly against a stub backend.

review.prompt: Refute that E0 is done: does the driver actually mediate ALL state transitions (never letting the backend touch state.json/gate.sh)? Is the lease heartbeat really pumped during a long task? Does the attempt cap and escalate-only policy hold, or is there a path that auto-fixes a blocked gate? Are the tests hollow (asserting the stub, not the driver)?

criteria.desc: hb-exec.js is requirable and exports run
the full regression suite is green

GATE_E1.desc: The Agno backend implements the wire protocol and degrades gracefully.

criteria.desc: agno_exec.py execute/refute emit protocol-shaped JSON (degrade path)
criteria.cmd: printf '{}' | python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/plugin/templates/executors/agno_exec.py" execute | grep -q '"ok"' && printf '{}' | python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/plugin/templates/executors/agno_exec.py" refute | grep -q '"refuted"'

criteria.desc: suite covers the agno adapter (T37 group PASSED)

GATE_E2.desc: The CrewAI backend implements the wire protocol and degrades gracefully.

criteria.desc: crewai_exec.py execute/refute emit protocol-shaped JSON (degrade path)
criteria.cmd: printf '{}' | python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/plugin/templates/executors/crewai_exec.py" execute | grep -q '"ok"' && printf '{}' | python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/plugin/templates/executors/crewai_exec.py" refute | grep -q '"refuted"'

criteria.desc: suite covers the crewai adapter (T38 group PASSED)

GATE_E3.desc: Shipped: bootstrap carries the executor, docs and version updated, suite green.

GATE_E4.desc: Parallel fan-out with worktree isolation, verified against the stub.

review.prompt: Refute that E4 is done: are the concurrent tasks REALLY isolated (a worktree per task) or can two tasks corrupt each other's writes? Is the merge-back serialized so the git index can't race? On a failed task, is its worktree actually discarded (not silently merged)? Does the attempt cap still hold under fan-out? Is T40 hollow (asserting the stub instead of real concurrency/isolation)?

criteria.desc: suite covers parallel execution (T40 group PASSED)

GATE_E5.desc: Ollama backend implements the wire protocol, degrades gracefully, and passed a live behavioral gate.

criteria.desc: ollama_exec.py execute/refute emit protocol-shaped JSON (dead-host degrade)
criteria.cmd: OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:9 python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/plugin/templates/executors/ollama_exec.py" execute <<<'{}' | grep -q '"ok"' && OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:9 python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/plugin/templates/executors/ollama_exec.py" refute <<<'{}' | grep -q '"refuted"'

criteria.desc: suite covers the ollama adapter (T41 group PASSED)
